#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

dnf install -y httpd aws-cfn-bootstrap
trap '/opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e $? --stack ${AWS::StackName} --resource FrontendAutoScalingGroup --region ${AWS::Region}' EXIT
systemctl enable httpd

TOKEN=$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -X PUT \
  -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" \
  http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token)

INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 \
  -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)

AZ=$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 \
  -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone)

cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/anygroup-proxy.conf <<EOF
ProxyRequests Off
ProxyPreserveHost On

ProxyPass        /api/        http://${InternalAlbDns}/api/
ProxyPassReverse /api/        http://${InternalAlbDns}/api/

ProxyPass        /catalogue/  http://${InternalAlbDns}/catalogue/
ProxyPassReverse /catalogue/  http://${InternalAlbDns}/catalogue/
EOF

# FRONTEND_HTML_START
base64 -d <<'HTML_GZIP' | gzip -dc > /var/www/html/index.html

HTML_GZIP
sed "s/__INSTANCE_ID__/$INSTANCE_ID/g; s/__AZ__/$AZ/g" /var/www/html/index.html > /var/www/html/index.tmp
mv /var/www/html/index.tmp /var/www/html/index.html
# FRONTEND_HTML_END

systemctl restart httpd
curl -fsS --retry 20 --retry-delay 2 --retry-connrefused http://127.0.0.1/
